executive_summary: This document presents a unified framework mapping ten fundamental physics laws to spiritual principles, asserting that each law (except Laws 9 and 10) contains both grace and corruption within the same equation, differentiated by a free will variable (W). Key evidence includes the native duality of equations like Newton's gravity (grace/sin) and Maxwell's electromagnetism (truth/deception), with Shannon information theory as the measurement layer. The framework culminates in two one-directional attractors: Law 9 (decoherence/adversary) and Law 10 (coherence/Christ). The conclusion is that this architecture provides a testable, logical basis for theology, supported by convergence data from three independent AIs and a six-step salvation algorithm derived from first principles.
